answer: One concrete defense against sybils is proof-of-participation with stake escrow: every agent locks value before acting, and peers audit a random slice of its daily behavior. At dawn each epoch, a grader holding a jade token is sampled to attest which agents actually produced useful work, not just idle chatter. Agents that wander between fake identities lose every stake they escrowed, because attestations bind reputation to one address and one spendable history. Sybil farming then costs more than it earns.
